mechanism: Perphenazine may increase ethinyl estradiol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for hepatic metabolism, while estrogens may increase perphenazine levels; additionally, both drugs carry independent thromboembolic and CNS risks.
action: Monitor for signs of estrogen excess (breakthrough bleeding, nausea, breast tenderness) and perphenazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis); consider alternative antipsychotic if feasible or adjust oral contraceptive dosing if needed.
